name: Japanese Bamboo Matcha Whisk
short_description: Traditional 100-prong bamboo whisk engraved with Ark Matcha.
description: Hand-cut from a single piece of bamboo, this traditional chasen whips matcha into a silky, frothy bowl. Engraved with the Ark Matcha mark.
storage: Rinse with warm water after use. Air-dry on a whisk holder to preserve the prongs.

name: Matcha Kit
